name: attention_decision
description: Decide how the companion reacts to one observed event.

attention.description: ignore = noise or user unavailable; queue = matters later, must not interrupt now; wake = the agent must consider it immediately

priority.description: how urgent the event is for the user

memory_candidate.description: true only for durable facts about the user, their preferences, projects or commitments; never for transient technical noise

route.description: cheapest sufficient path: none = nothing to do, task = update an existing task, agent = full reasoning required
